description: Calculate true sloped roof surface area, roofing squares (100 ft²), and shingle bundles from building footprint, pitch, overhang, and waste.

bundlesPerSquare.description: Shingle bundles per 100 ft² square (1-6). Default 3.

footprintArea.description: Known horizontal footprint area (ft² in us, m² in metric).

length.description: Building footprint length (ft in us, m in metric). Provide length+width OR footprintArea.

overhang.description: Eave/rake overhang on each side (ft in us, m in metric). Default 0.

width.description: Building footprint width (ft in us, m in metric).

name: calculate_roofing
title: Roof Area & Shingle Calculator
